summary: Sukumari Bhattacharji was an Indologist who studied at the University of Calcutta and Jadavpur University. She was a professor of English at Lady Brabourne College in 1945 and taught at Jadavpur University from 1957 to 1986.
Sulagna Bhattacharya is an Indologist who completed doctoral studies under Pratap Bandyopadhyay. Bhattacharya held an H P Shastri Research Fellowship at The Asiatic Society, attested in 2026.

Sulak Sivaraksa is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who studied at Lampeter, Assumption College, and SSRC. Sivaraksa held visiting posts at Berkeley, Harvard, Toronto, and Cornell, and was an honorary fellow at Lampeter.

Sumathi Ramaswamy is a historian and Indologist who studied at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Pennsylvania. Her career includes posts at the University of Pennsylvania and the University of Michigan.

Sumi Lee is a scholar of Buddhist studies. Lee completed an MA under Alexander L. Mayer at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and a PhD under Robert E. Buswell Jr. at the University of California, Los Angeles.

Sumitra Mangesh Katre was a linguist and Indologist who earned a PhD at the University of London. He founded Deccan College, serving as Chair of Indo-European Philology (1942–1971), and later became Professor Emeritus at UT Austin.

Sun-Ah Choi works in Buddhist studies, history, and archaeology. Choi earned a PhD from the University of Chicago under doctoral supervisor Juhyung Rhi, having also studied under Richard Neer, Robert S. Nelson, Jaś Elsner, and Aden Kumler.

Sunanda Mukhopadhyay is an Indologist and linguist who studied under doctoral supervisor Shyam Sundar Bhattacharya. Mukhopadhyay was attested in 2026 as a Research Scholar / Fellow at The Asiatic Society.

Sung Yong Kang is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied at Seoul National University and the University of Hamburg. Kang held posts at the University of Vienna (~2006–2008) and Seoul National University (~2008, attested 2022).

Sung-Bae Park is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed his PhD under Lewis Lancaster. He was an assistant professor at Dongguk University (~1968–1972) and later became Professor Emeritus at Stony Brook University.

Sungdoo Ahn is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar who earned a PhD at the University of Hamburg under Lambert Schmithausen. Ahn served as Director at Geumgang University and as a professor at Seoul National University.
Sungtaek Cho is a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy. Cho held posts at Stony Brook University and Korea University, serving as Director (2003) and Professor (attested 2017) at the latter.
Sunhee Kim earned a Doctor of Philosophy in Performance Practice from the University of Exeter under the supervision of Phillip B. Zarrilli (attested 2013).

Suniti Kumar Chatterji was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Calcutta, London, and Paris under Jules Bloch. He was Khaira Professor at the University of Calcutta (1922–1952) and Government of India National Professor in Humanities (1965–1977).
Supree Kanjanapisarn is a scholar of religious studies and philosophy who completed a PhD at Assumption University under the supervision of Veerachart Nimanong, attested in 2011.

Surama Dasgupta was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Surendranath Dasgupta, earning degrees from the University of Calcutta and the University of Cambridge. She served as Reader in the Philosophy Department at the University of Lucknow.
Surendra Man Bajracharya is a scholar in Buddhist studies who completed a PhD at Tribhuvan University under doctoral supervisor Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya and co-supervisor Ranjana Bajracharya.

Surendranath Dasgupta was a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied at Calcutta and Cambridge under McTaggart and Ward. He held principalships at Sanskrit College and Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, and served as Chair of Philosophy at Calcutta.
Surendranath Majumdar Sastri was an Indology and history scholar who studied under traditional teacher Hara Prasad Sastri and served as a Reader at Patna University (attested 1924).
Surya Das is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied at the University at Buffalo from 1967 to 1971 and under traditional teacher Nyoshul Khenpo Rinpoche from ~1984 to 1999.
